content:
deploy-bot: Scheduled v2 rollout window open for /api/v2 at 2026-03-25T22:00Z. Canary config: 1% traffic, 4-min health window, auto-fallback to v1 on schema mismatch. Release lead: maggie.product. Link: https://go/internal/deploy/178001

maggie.product: Quick preflight: telemetry dashboards, release notes draft, operator handoff doc — status?

ryan.platform: Telemetry updated (route /api/v2) - p50/p95/p99, error-rate, plus synthetic tests for schema boundaries. Link in deploy plan.

sara-oncall: Added runbook alerts: error_rate > 0.5% sustained 3m OR p95 > 300ms for 5m -> pause canary and page.

ben-eng: FYI some older mobile SDKs only send v1 header. Recommend generating a tenant pinlist prior to ramp. I'll scan client signals.

maggie.product: Please do. Required by EOD: tenant IDs + reason tags (mobile <2.3.0, embedded devices). ops will apply pins.

ben-eng: Scan command I'll run:
```
python infra/tools/client_signal_scan.py --since 7d --header 'x-rw-api-version' | jq '.clients[] | {tenant, sdk_version}'
```

ops-liz: Pin command when ready:
```
deployctl tenant-pin --tenant <id> --route /api/v2 --pin-to v1 --reason "preflight-compat"
```
I'll schedule pin application in low-traffic WA/NA window.

maggie.product: Release notes: draft at docs/releases/v2.md. Need a short migration blurb for SDK teams and a changelog entry. @ryan.platform can you add a migration bullet?

ryan.platform: Added migration steps and a brief troubleshooting note for 422 schema validation failures.

sara-oncall: Who's primary operator for the first 2 hours? Also confirm escalation if automated fallback fails.

maggie.product: Primary: sara-oncall first 60m, then ops-liz. Escalation: oncall -> release lead (maggie) -> eng lead (ben). Manual routing switch via gateway-control in runbook if fallback fails.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: model compatibility tests PASS; schema dry-run OK; KV cache warmup OK.

ben-eng: Noted header casing mismatch in signals (x-RW-Api-version vs x-rw-api-version). Gateway will normalize; we'll add tolerant check in v2 during canary.

maggie.product: Add note to release notes and ensure pinlist includes tenants with odd header casing.

ops-liz: Pinlist ready; applying pins during midnight window. Will confirm when done.

sara-oncall: Added rollback signal: token-intake drop >15% combined with error_rate >0.2% -> pause. Saw this pattern before.

maggie.product: Agreed, include in health policy.

ryan.platform: Will cap large function/tool calls for canary: set max_tokens_request=2048 to limit p99 tail.

ben-eng: Approved.

 deploy-bot: Canary started: 1% traffic -> /api/v2

maggie.product: Monitoring dashboards. @sara-oncall pause if anomalies or client regressions on pinned tenants.

sara-oncall: Seeing a few 422s from integration tests hitting strict schema path; investigating.

ben-eng: Logs show two test tenants failing due to enum change in "response_type". I'll patch v2 to accept previous enum values for soft-compat during canary.

maggie.product: Land patch and redeploy canary; keep operators informed.

ben-eng: Patch landed; canary redeploying.

 deploy-bot: Canary redeploy successful. Health checks continuing.

ops-liz: Applied pins to 14 tenants (mobile <2.3.0 + embedded). Monitoring for any unpin requests.

sara-oncall: Health stable at 1% for 12m — p95 120ms, error_rate 0.03%.

maggie.product: Plan to step to 5% in 30m if stable. Update changelog with header-casing note and SDK contact.

ryan.platform: Added SDK contact.

deploy-bot: Scheduled step to 5% in 5m. Cancel if alerts.

(5 minutes pass)

sara-oncall: Stepping now to 5%.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic now 5%.

ben-eng: Noticing small uptick in 500s from backend shard-7; investigating.

sara-oncall: Alert: error_rate >0.5% in eu-west-1 for 2m. Threshold is 3m but recommend pausing early. @maggie.product

maggie.product: Pause canary.

deploy-bot: Canary paused by maggie.product. Traffic rolled back to 1%; ramps halted. Reason: eu-west-1 error spike on shard-7.

ben-eng: Logs indicate resource saturation on shard-7 due to kernel selector mismatch after runtime selector update. Options: kernel fallback or route traffic off shard-7 for v2.

ryan.platform: I can route v2 away from shard-7 for eu-west to stabilize; capacity will be reduced.

ops-liz: Prefer kernel fallback if under 15m; otherwise route-around.

ben-eng: Kernel fallback patch ready, applying now.

deploy-bot: Kernel fallback applied; restarting workers on shard-7.

sara-oncall: Monitoring — error rate in eu-west dropping.

ben-eng: eu-west error rate back to baseline (0.04%); p95 stable. Recommend resuming to 5% and hold 30m.

maggie.product: Resume to 5% and hold 30m.

deploy-bot: Canary resumed to 5% by maggie.product. Hold timer 30m started.

sara-oncall: Hold in progress. All pinned tenants unaffected. No rollback required.

maggie.product: I'll update release notes with kernel fallback incident and add operator guidance for future rollouts.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by maggie.product after hold timer started. Final: canary paused/resumed -> stable at 5%.
